subject: Commitment shift & implementation-clause coordination
messages:
From: Nora Chen <nora.chen@cedarai.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: CedarAI Legal <legal@cedarai.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Request: move committed units between SKUs / DPA questions

Hi Markus,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from procurement: CedarAI needs to shift a portion of our reserved commitment under deal RW-CE-4782. Specifically, we’d like to move 20% of our committed units from GPU-XL (high-memory) into GPU-L (standard) for the remainder of the term. We want to avoid an entirely new SOW if possible.

Two things we need from you:
- Commercial: proposed price delta and whether Redwood will provide a commensurate credit/true-up for the rebalancing (we prefer a pro-rata credit applied to the next invoice).
- Legal: confirmation whether this change triggers any MSA or DPA revisions (our security team is asking about data residency & audit logging implications).

Can you share a short draft amendment (or confirm you can do a commercial-only change order) and an implementation timeline? Our preferred effective date is Nov 20, 2026. Procurement will route for signature once we have the redline.

Thanks — Nora
Nora Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager, CedarAI
[Attachment: current_orderform_RW-CE-4782.pdf (pdf)]

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Nora Chen <nora.chen@cedarai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: move committed units between SKUs / DPA questions

Nora — thanks for the clear ask. We can do this as an amendment (change order) that reassigns committed units between SKUs rather than a full SOW rewrite. High-level notes:

- Commercial flow: we’ll calculate a pro-rata true-up for the remaining term and apply a credit to the next invoice. Laura (cc’d) will send a one-page commercial illustration and an updated Order Form workbook.
- Legal/DPA: redlining required only if the customer requires changes to data residency, logging, or KMS integrations. Otherwise this is commercial-only (Order Form + amendment) and can be routed directly to DocuSign.
- Implementation: product-side change should be limited — we expect a configuration reassign and no migration, but we’ll validate with engineering. Target effective date Nov 20 is feasible pending sign-off.

I’ve asked Laura to circulate the commercial workbook and Hannah (legal) to start the MSA/DPA assessment. Please confirm if Nov 20 works for CedarAI.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Nora Chen <nora.chen@cedarai.com>, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 13:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Commercial: SKU rebalance worksheet and credit calc (RW-CE-4782)

Nora — attaching the OrderForm SKU rebalance workbook (see attachment). Summary below so procurement has something to review quickly:

- Move: 20% of committed units from GPU-XL to GPU-L across remaining 10 months of term.
- Price delta: GPU-L is $0.045/token lower (list); net impact across term is a credit of $18,900.
- Proposed handling: apply credit against next invoice; if invoice already issued we’ll issue a one-time credit memo.
- Effective date: Nov 20, 2026 (pending DocuSign).

Attachment: OrderForm_SKU_rebalance.xlsx (commercial workbook with line-item math).

If this approach is acceptable, we’ll hand the attached workbook to Legal to incorporate a short amendment (1 page) referencing the existing MSA + Order Form. Jordan — when you’ve confirmed the workbook numbers, can you push the HubSpot deal stage to Contract Review so finance knows to expect the credit memo?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: OrderForm_SKU_rebalance.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Nora Chen <nora.chen@cedarai.com>, legal@cedarai.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Commercial: SKU rebalance worksheet and credit calc (RW-CE-4782) — legal redline and DPA note

Markus / Laura — reviewed the workbook and commercial approach. We can support the commitment shift as a short amendment ("Order Form Amendment") that:

1) Updates Exhibit A (Order Form) line items to reflect SKU reallocation and the resulting credit.
2) Leaves the MSA text untouched unless CedarAI requests changes to data handling controls.

That said, two items for CedarAI to confirm so we can finalize the redline:
- Data residency / DPA: CedarAI’s note about residency / audit logging — does your security team require an explicit DPA addendum that references HSM or customer-managed KMS? If so, we’ll need to incorporate an Addendum (DPA Addendum) which may add review time.
- Implementation detail: does the shift require moving any workloads between regions (AP/US/EU)? If yes, we need an implementation window and a short SLA note.

I’ve attached a legal redline PDF that shows our proposed one-page amendment (MSA_redline_markus_v3.pdf). The redline intentionally keeps changes to the Order Form only and includes an explicit effective-date clause. If CedarAI confirms no DPA changes, we can route to DocuSign and hit Nov 20. If they require DPA edits, expect a 5–7 business day review.

Quick excerpt from the redline: "This Amendment modifies the Order Form only; all other terms of the Master Services Agreement (MSA) remain in full force and effect unless explicitly modified below. Effective Date: [Nov 20, 2026]."

Please see the attached timeline for the necessary steps (Implementation_Timeline_20261112.xlsx). Jordan — I included suggested signatory order and HubSpot doc links in comments.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_redline_markus_v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Nora Chen <nora.chen@cedarai.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com, legal@cedarai.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Commercial: SKU rebalance worksheet and credit calc (RW-CE-4782) — legal redline and DPA note

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear redline.

CedarAI confirms:
- No change to data residency or customer KMS in this request — we do not need a DPA addendum.
- No region migration; configuration-only change is fine.
- We can accept the Amendment as drafted with Effective Date Nov 20, 2026.

Procurement will route the redline for signature once we receive the DocuSign link. Please include the credit memo language as shown in Laura’s workbook.

Next steps: please send DocuSign and we’ll sign on our side by EOD Nov 17.

Nora Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager, CedarAI
[Attachment: CedarAI_PO_approved_1112.pdf (pdf)]
